Who's to blame for the toxic smog choking South East Asia?
- Published
As Indonesia battles its worst wildfire season in a decade, a toxic smog is choking millions of residents in the region.
The air on the islands of Kalimantan and Sumatra has turned an ominous amber, with air quality recorded at hazardous levels.
The smog - or haze - has drifted beyond Indonesia's borders to neighbouring countries, raising public health concerns. It has obscured Singapore's skyline and forced some schools to close in Malaysia.
Now, anger is mounting at the companies accused of burning farmland, as well as the authorities who have struggled to stop them.
The annual dry season wildfires have been especially intense this year because of an unusually strong El Niño: a natural climate phenomenon which changes weather patterns around the world.
According to independent forest monitoring platform Nusantara Atlas, 1,043,377 wildfire hotspots have been recorded in Indonesia, burning a total of 900,000 hectares of land.
Slash and burn
Many of these fires in Indonesia's forests and peatlands are caused by the razing of vegetation to clear land - a practice known as "slash and burn".
This is an agricultural method that has traditionally been employed by farmers in Indonesia to create nutrient-rich soil for new crops.
But today, many of these fires are associated with commercial farming and are taking place on a much larger scale - and are harder to control. Activists and government investigations have repeatedly accused some companies of using fire as a cheap way to clear large swathes of land.
While slash-and-burn farming is illegal in Indonesia, enforcement of a ban has long proven tricky.
But persistent haze this year has prompted Indonesian authorities to step up efforts to punish offenders.
Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has called for tougher sanctions against slash-and-burn farming, describing the practice as "ecological terrorism".
Last month, Indonesian authorities announced they had suspended the operating licences of 26 companies linked to the wildfires and launched investigations into others. Cases involving criminal elements would be taken to court, officials vowed.

title: Burnham to host Zelenskyy at No 10 in show of ‘rock-solid’ support
content_c:
Andy Burnham will host Volodymyr Zelenskyy at Downing Street on Wednesday as the UK seeks to further underline its support for the Ukrainian president, in contrast to his difficulties with Donald Trump.
The UK prime minister said his message to Zelenskyy and his country would be: “We are with you for as long as it takes.”
To coincide with the visit, the UK has said it will move more rapidly in providing Ukraine with British-made lightweight multi-role missiles (LMMs) to help protect it from attacks by a new generation of Russian jet-powered drones.
In parallel, Burnham and his ministers will push for a full international maritime services ban on exports of Russian liquefied natural gas (LNG).
The pair have already met twice since Burnham took office in July, when Zelenskyy visited a naval base in Portsmouth in the same month and when Burnham travelled to Kyiv in August.
Zelenskyy’s latest visit comes as Ukraine faces increased Russian missile and drone attacks, and after Donald Trump made a deal to buy Russian diesel, called for Ukraine to have a new leader, and announced a supposed ceasefire connected to energy infrastructure that the Ukrainian president said “was news to him”.
Trump is an often wayward ally for Ukraine, and Zelenskyy has expressed anger at the diesel deal, saying subsequent Russian attacks on civilian targets in Ukraine amounted to a “thanks” from Vladimir Putin.
UK governments have previously welcomed Zelenskyy after difficult experiences with Trump. He met Keir Starmer at Downing Street the day after Trump and his vice-president, JD Vance, publicly berated the Ukrainian president in the Oval Office 18 months ago.
During that trip Zelenskyy was also hosted by King Charles, who, in a pointedly personal touch, saw the Ukrainian president at Sandringham in Norfolk, which is a royal family home and rarely used for such visits.
Announcing the latest Downing Street meeting, No 10 said part of an ongoing £1.6bn package to deliver more than 5,000 LMMs to Ukraine would be sped up to help combat attacks by jet-powered drones.
These are quicker and higher-flying than the propeller-driven Shahed drones previously used, making them much harder to shoot down, allowing Russia to strike more targets in Ukraine, including in Kyiv.
The chancellor, John Healey, will separately use meetings at the ongoing International Monetary Fund summit in Bangkok to push other countries to ban Russian LNG.
In a statement before his meeting with Zelenskyy, Burnham said: “Our rock-solid support to Ukraine is vital for keeping us safe here in the UK and ensuring those on the frontlines have the equipment they need to push back Russia.
“My message to the Ukrainian people could not be clearer: we are with you for as long as it takes, and we will go further and faster in our support to back your courageous fight for peace in Europe.
“It is not just the right thing to do, but it’s the necessary thing to do. Russia’s aggression cannot be allowed to succeed on our continent.”

title: Hungary's parliament votes to reverse anti-LGBTQ legislation from Orban era
content_c:
Hungary: Lawmakers scrap Orban-era anti-LGBTQ+ provisions
October 13, 2026
Hungary's parliament on Tuesday passed a bill amending a 2021 law targeting the LGBTQ+ community that was passed under nationalist ex-leader Viktor Orban.
The 2021 "child protection" law introduced restrictions on the "portrayal" or "promotion" of sexual and gender diversity in content accessible to children. In reality, this meant that even books addressing these topics in an age-appropriate manner could only be sold in black plastic packaging with warnings.
Critics argued that the law promoted the bigoted view automatically linking homosexuality and child abuse. The European Court of Justice had also ruled in April that it violated EU treaties.
Tuesday's amendment repeals most of the statute, except the provision protecting under-18s from sexually explicit or violent material. It passed with the support of the governing majority, with 139 lawmakers voting in favor and 51 against.
What brought about this change?
Hungary's longtime Prime Minister Viktor Orban was voted out of office in April. While his successor Peter Magyar is also a conservative and an immigration hardliner, he promised to break with Orban's repressive policies on media, the judiciary, and other issues.
Magyar has promised to dismantle what he calls the rampant corruption and authoritarian structures put in place under Orban's government.
"We welcome this important signal of commitment for our common values," EU commissioners Michael McGrath and Hadja Lahbib said in a joint statement. The bloc then unfroze €4.2 billion ($4.7 billion) in funding to Hungary following the vote.
Edited by: Jenipher Camino Gonzalez and Wesley Dockery

title: Champions League: Nicolò Tresoldi trifft dreifach im San Siro und glänzt in Mailand
content_c:
Champions League Barcelona dreht Partie in der »Hölle« von Istanbul, U21-Spieler Tresoldi trifft dreifach in Mailand
RB Leipzig hat am 2. Spieltag der Champions-League-Saison einen 1:0 (0:0)-Sieg gegen PSV Eindhoven aus den Niederlanden eingefahren. Dass der Bundesligist zur Pause nicht in Rückstand lag, hatte RB seinem Torwart Maarten Vandevoord zu verdanken, der einen Elfmeter von Ivan Perišić hielt. Zuvor war eine Flanke an den Arm von Ridle Baku geflogen, nach Sichtung der Videobilder hatte der Schiedsrichter auf Strafstoß entschieden.
Mit einem Schuss von der Strafraumkante brachte Brajan Gruda RB in der zweiten Hälfte in Führung. Kurzzeitig mussten die Leipziger Fans zittern, als ein vermeintlicher Treffer von PSV-Profi Armando Obispo vom Videoschiedsrichter überprüft wurde. Doch er stand im Abseits.
Die Fans von Galatasaray Istanbul konnten von einem Außenseitersieg träumen: Der Hexenkessel von Istanbul explodierte in der ersten Hälfte, als Aleksey Batrakov Gala in Führung brachte. Kurzzeitig hatten die türkischen Fans in ihrem Stadion, genannt »Hölle«, noch mehr Grund zu jubeln. Doch ein Tor von Baris Yilmaz wurde wegen einer Abseitsstellung aberkannt.
Stattdessen glich Barcelonas João Cancelo noch vor der Halbzeit für die Gäste aus. Nach der Pause schockierten die Spanier die Gala-Anhänger: Fermín López und Anthony Gordon sorgten per Doppelschlag innerhalb von drei Minuten für die Vorentscheidung. Der Deutsche Karim Adeyemi traf per Direktabnahme zum Endstand.
In der heimischen Premier League hat Manchester United einen Fehlstart hingelegt, in der Königsklasse mussten die Engländer nun ebenfalls einen Rückschlag hinnehmen. Die spanischen Gastgeber aus Madrid gingen nach einem abgefälschten Schuss von Pablo Barrios bereits in der ersten Minute in Führung. Manchester spielte ab der 74. Minute nach einer Roten Karte für Leny Yoro wegen einer Notbremse in Unterzahl. Joker Ademola Lookman sorgte nach einem Konter mit dem 2:0 für die Entscheidung.
U21-Nationalspieler Nicolò Tresoldi hat einen Dreierpack gegen Inter Mailand gefeiert. Der deutsch-italienische Angreifer, der sich bei der A-Nationalmannschaft immer noch für Italien entscheiden könnte, brillierte vor dem italienischen Publikum im legendären San-Siro-Stadion. Erst brachte er den Außenseiter aus Belgien in Führung, in der zweiten Hälfte bereitete er dann mit einem Doppelpack Brügges Sieg in Mailand den Weg.
Weitere Ergebnisse:
RC Lens vs. Sporting Lissabon 0:2 (0:1)
Sabah FK vs. Slavia Prag 2:0 (0:0)
FC Arsenal vs. Lille OSC 3:0 (0:0)
FC Villareal vs. SSC Neapel 3:1 (2:1)

title: Immer mehr Suizide in Deutschland - Experten fordern Prävention
content_c:
Mehr Prävention gefordert Zahl der Suizide deutlich gestiegen
In Deutschland steigt die Zahl der Suizide weiter. Experten fordern mehr Prävention und niedrigschwellige Hilfe. Doch ein Entwurf des Gesundheitsministeriums für ein Gesetz lässt auf sich warten.
Die Zahl der Suizide in Deutschland ist weiter gestiegen. Vergangenes Jahr haben sich 11.334 Menschen das Leben genommen, wie das Statistische Bundesamt mitteilte. Das waren 9,3 Prozent oder 964 Fälle mehr als im Vorjahr - und 15,6 Prozent mehr als im Durchschnitt der vergangenen zehn Jahre.
Damit kommen in Deutschland weiterhin mehr Menschen pro Jahr durch Suizid zu Tode als durch Verkehrsunfälle, Mord, Totschlag und AIDS zusammen. An den Sterbefällen insgesamt machten Suizide vergangenes Jahr 1,1 Prozent aus, wie die Statistiker mitteilten.
Allerdings steigt die Zahl seit 2021 kontinuierlich an. Das ist den Angaben zufolge seit drei Jahren vor allem auf mehr Suizide bei Frauen zurückzuführen. Deren Anteil stieg in dem Zeitraum um 17,9 Prozent, während es bei den Männern eine geringere Zunahme (5,8 Prozent) gab. Insgesamt nahmen sich vergangenes Jahr aber mehr Männer (69,2 Prozent) das Leben als Frauen (30,8 Prozent), wie es weiter hieß.
Telefonnummern der Telefonseelsorge: 0800/111 0 111 und 0800/111 0 222 www.telefonseelsorge.de
Telefonberatung für Kinder und Jugendliche: 116 111 - www.nummergegenkummer.de
Assistierter Suizid trägt zu Anstieg bei
Ein weiterer Grund für den Anstieg der Zahlen ist assistierter Suizid. Die Deutsche Gesellschaft für Humanes Sterben nahm 2025 nach eigenen Angaben deutlich mehr Suizidbegleitungen vor - nämlich bei 1.287 Menschen. Im Vorjahr seien es 1.200 gewesen. Die Stiftung Depressionshilfe spricht von einem Anstieg seit 2020 um fast 32 Prozent.
Hintergrund ist eine Entscheidung des Bundesverfassungsgerichts von 2020. Die Karlsruher Richterinnen und Richter hatten geurteilt, dass jeder Mensch das verfassungsmäßig geschützte Recht hat, sich selbst zu töten. Die einzige Voraussetzung: Der Sterbewillige muss sich aus freiem Willen dazu entscheiden - ohne Druck von außen oder aufgrund von schweren Depressionen. Die Tätigkeit von Sterbehilfeorganisationen wurde daraufhin wieder zugelassen.
Zugleich appellierte das Verfassungsgericht an die Bundesregierung, einen Rahmen für Suizidbeihilfe zu schaffen, um Freiwilligkeit zu garantieren und Missbrauch zu verhindern. Um eine Neuregelung der Suizidbeihilfe wird seither im Bundestag gerungen.
Gesetzentwurf für bundesweite Hilfe
Im August hatte das Gesundheitsministerium einen Referentenentwurf für ein Präventionsgesetz vorgelegt. Das sieht unter anderem vor, eine Bundesfachstelle für Suizidprävention zu schaffen. Diese soll eine bundesweit einheitliche Krisendienst-Telefonnummer aufbauen. Zudem soll es Modellvorhaben zu Maßnahmen der Suizidprävention geben. Länder und Kommunen sollen besser unterstützt werden, um einen flächendeckenden Krisendienst auszubauen.
Kritik gab es aber an dem vorgesehenen Budget für die neue Bundesfachstelle: 1,4 Millionen Euro sieht der Entwurf vor. Das sei viel zu wenig, kritisierte die Deutsche Stiftung Patientenschutz. Der Deutsche Caritasverband monierte, es fehlten Vorschläge für eine dauerhafte Finanzierung der Krisenhilfe. Auch gehe der Referentenentwurf nicht auf die Prävention assistierter Suizide ein und schaffe keine zusätzlichen Plätze in Hospizen und der Palliativ-Versorgung.
Hilfe über Hausarzt, Telefon oder Gruppenangebote
Noch viel höher als die Zahl der Suizide ist die der Versuche. Nach Schätzungen des Nationalen Suizidpräventionsprogramms unternehmen jährlich weit über 100.000 Menschen einen Suizidversuch. Die Stiftung Deutsche Depressionshilfe spricht von schätzungsweise 500 Menschen pro Tag.
Auch diese Menschen brauchen dringend Ansprechpartner. Noch ist die erste Anlaufstelle der Hausarzt oder die Hausärztin. Er oder sie kann Betroffene an einen Psychologen oder Psychiater überweisen. Wer nicht persönlich in eine Praxis gehen möchte, kann auch telefonisch Hilfe in Anspruch nehmen. Das Info-Telefon Depression hilft unter der Nummer 0800-3344533. Auch die Telefonseelsorge (0800-1110111, 0800-1110222 oder 116123, auch per Chat oder Mail) ist eine Anlaufstelle.
Zudem gibt es Selbsthilfegruppen und Beratungsangebote, etwa beim Bundesverband der Angehörigen psychisch erkrankter Menschen. Besteht eine akute Lebensgefahr, sollten Betroffene umgehend die nächste psychiatrische Klinik aufsuchen oder den Notarzt unter 112 rufen.
Experten: Angehörige sollten Suizidgedanken ernst nehmen
Die Stiftung Depressionshilfe rät Angehörigen und Freunden, Suizidankündigungen immer ernst zu nehmen. Äußerungen wie: "Es hat alles gar keinen Sinn mehr..." sind Hinweise auf eine ernste Gefährdung. Freunde oder Familienangehörige sollten keine Scheu haben, genauer nachzufragen, raten die Experten. Oft sei es für einen suizidgefährdeten Menschen eine Entlastung, mit einer anderen Person über die quälenden Gedanken sprechen zu können.
Die Stiftung mahnt zudem, sich mit gut gemeinten Ratschlägen zurückzuhalten. Schlichte Botschaften wie "Du bist mir wichtig", "Ich versuche, diese Krankheit zu verstehen" oder "Wir schaffen das zusammen" seien am wirkungsvollsten.
description: In Deutschland steigt die Zahl der Suizide weiter. Experten fordern mehr Prävention und niedrigschwellige Hilfe. Doch ein Entwurf des Gesundheitsministeriums für ein Gesetz lässt auf sich warten.
content:
Mehr Prävention gefordert Zahl der Suizide deutlich gestiegen
In Deutschland steigt die Zahl der Suizide weiter. Experten fordern mehr Prävention und niedrigschwellige Hilfe. Doch ein Entwurf des Gesundheitsministeriums für ein Gesetz lässt auf sich warten.
Die Zahl der Suizide in Deutschland ist weiter gestiegen. Vergangenes Jahr haben sich 11.334 Menschen das Leben genommen, wie das Statistische Bundesamt mitteilte. Das waren 9,3 Prozent oder 964 Fälle mehr als im Vorjahr - und 15,6 Prozent mehr als im Durchschnitt der vergangenen zehn Jahre.
Damit kommen in Deutschland weiterhin mehr Menschen pro Jahr durch Suizid zu Tode als durch Verkehrsunfälle, Mord, Totschlag und AIDS zusammen. An den Sterbefällen insgesamt machten Suizide vergangenes Jahr 1,1 Prozent aus, wie die Statistiker mitteilten.
Allerdings steigt die Zahl seit 2021 kontinuierlich an. Das ist den Angaben zufolge seit drei Jahren vor allem auf mehr Suizide bei Frauen zurückzuführen. Deren Anteil stieg in dem Zeitraum um 17,9 Prozent, während es bei den Männern eine geringere Zunahme (5,8 Prozent) gab. Insgesamt nahmen sich vergangenes Jahr aber mehr Männer (69,2 Prozent) das Leben als Frauen (30,8 Prozent), wie es weiter hieß.
Telefonnummern der Telefonseelsorge: 0800/111 0 111 und 0800/111 0 222 www.telefonseelsorge.de
Telefonberatung für Kinder und Jugendliche: 116 111 - www.nummergegenkummer.de
Assistierter Suizid trägt zu Anstieg bei
Ein weiterer Grund für den Anstieg der Zahlen ist assistierter Suizid. Die Deutsche Gesellschaft für Humanes Sterben nahm 2025 nach eigenen Angaben deutlich mehr Suizidbegleitungen vor - nämlich bei 1.287 Menschen. Im Vorjahr seien es 1.200 gewesen. Die Stiftung Depressionshilfe spricht von einem Anstieg seit 2020 um fast 32 Prozent.
Hintergrund ist eine Entscheidung des Bundesverfassungsgerichts von 2020. Die Karlsruher Richterinnen und Richter hatten geurteilt, dass jeder Mensch das verfassungsmäßig geschützte Recht hat, sich selbst zu töten. Die einzige Voraussetzung: Der Sterbewillige muss sich aus freiem Willen dazu entscheiden - ohne Druck von außen oder aufgrund von schweren Depressionen. Die Tätigkeit von Sterbehilfeorganisationen wurde daraufhin wieder zugelassen.
Zugleich appellierte das Verfassungsgericht an die Bundesregierung, einen Rahmen für Suizidbeihilfe zu schaffen, um Freiwilligkeit zu garantieren und Missbrauch zu verhindern. Um eine Neuregelung der Suizidbeihilfe wird seither im Bundestag gerungen.
Gesetzentwurf für bundesweite Hilfe
Im August hatte das Gesundheitsministerium einen Referentenentwurf für ein Präventionsgesetz vorgelegt. Das sieht unter anderem vor, eine Bundesfachstelle für Suizidprävention zu schaffen. Diese soll eine bundesweit einheitliche Krisendienst-Telefonnummer aufbauen. Zudem soll es Modellvorhaben zu Maßnahmen der Suizidprävention geben. Länder und Kommunen sollen besser unterstützt werden, um einen flächendeckenden Krisendienst auszubauen.
Kritik gab es aber an dem vorgesehenen Budget für die neue Bundesfachstelle: 1,4 Millionen Euro sieht der Entwurf vor. Das sei viel zu wenig, kritisierte die Deutsche Stiftung Patientenschutz. Der Deutsche Caritasverband monierte, es fehlten Vorschläge für eine dauerhafte Finanzierung der Krisenhilfe. Auch gehe der Referentenentwurf nicht auf die Prävention assistierter Suizide ein und schaffe keine zusätzlichen Plätze in Hospizen und der Palliativ-Versorgung.
Hilfe über Hausarzt, Telefon oder Gruppenangebote
Noch viel höher als die Zahl der Suizide ist die der Versuche. Nach Schätzungen des Nationalen Suizidpräventionsprogramms unternehmen jährlich weit über 100.000 Menschen einen Suizidversuch. Die Stiftung Deutsche Depressionshilfe spricht von schätzungsweise 500 Menschen pro Tag.
Auch diese Menschen brauchen dringend Ansprechpartner. Noch ist die erste Anlaufstelle der Hausarzt oder die Hausärztin. Er oder sie kann Betroffene an einen Psychologen oder Psychiater überweisen. Wer nicht persönlich in eine Praxis gehen möchte, kann auch telefonisch Hilfe in Anspruch nehmen. Das Info-Telefon Depression hilft unter der Nummer 0800-3344533. Auch die Telefonseelsorge (0800-1110111, 0800-1110222 oder 116123, auch per Chat oder Mail) ist eine Anlaufstelle.
Zudem gibt es Selbsthilfegruppen und Beratungsangebote, etwa beim Bundesverband der Angehörigen psychisch erkrankter Menschen. Besteht eine akute Lebensgefahr, sollten Betroffene umgehend die nächste psychiatrische Klinik aufsuchen oder den Notarzt unter 112 rufen.
Experten: Angehörige sollten Suizidgedanken ernst nehmen
Die Stiftung Depressionshilfe rät Angehörigen und Freunden, Suizidankündigungen immer ernst zu nehmen. Äußerungen wie: "Es hat alles gar keinen Sinn mehr..." sind Hinweise auf eine ernste Gefährdung. Freunde oder Familienangehörige sollten keine Scheu haben, genauer nachzufragen, raten die Experten. Oft sei es für einen suizidgefährdeten Menschen eine Entlastung, mit einer anderen Person über die quälenden Gedanken sprechen zu können.
Die Stiftung mahnt zudem, sich mit gut gemeinten Ratschlägen zurückzuhalten. Schlichte Botschaften wie "Du bist mir wichtig", "Ich versuche, diese Krankheit zu verstehen" oder "Wir schaffen das zusammen" seien am wirkungsvollsten.

title: "Дуже смачно!": українка показала, як готувати голубці з цибулі — їх обожнюють в Німеччині
content_c:
"Дуже смачно!": українка показала, як готувати голубці з цибулі — їх обожнюють в Німеччині
Українська біженка поділилася секретами німецької кухні та розповіла, як приготувати ніжну фаршировану цибулю в соковитому соусі.
У Німеччині місцеві жителі готують надзвичайно цікаву та оригінальну страву — фаршировану цибулю, яка слугує традиційним замінником класичних капустяних голубців у місцевій гастрономічній культурі вже майже двісті років.
Українська біженка Людмила Русіна, яка через війну виїхала до Німеччини, поділилася враженнями від кулінарних традицій цієї країни та розповіла про місцеву страву, що стала для неї справжнім відкриттям. Вона описала рецепт німецької інтерпретації знайомих усім голубців, де замість капустяного листя використовують цибулю.
Людмила зазначила, що німці готують фаршировану цибулю вже майже два століття, а самі рецепти за цей час неодноразово змінювалися. За її словами, для цієї страви в Німеччині є навіть окремий сорт цибулі під назвою «Gemüsezwiebel», який має солодкуватий присмак, хоча для приготування можна використовувати звичайну.
«Німці роблять голубці з цибулі. В них навіть цибуля для цього є спеціальна –„Gemüsezwiebel». Вона трохи солодша, але підійде і звичайна. Цибулю треба надрізати і відварити у підсоленій воді з лавровим листком 15 хвилин. Для начинки: змішати фарш, рис, одне яйце, подрібнену цибулину, ложку томатного соусу. Обов’язково потрібно додати гірчицю з майораном і сіль із перцем», — розповіла українка.
Вона пояснила, що відварену цибулю розділяють на окремі шари, кожен з яких наповнюють приготованим фаршем. Для соусу використовують томатний сік або розведену водою томатну пасту з додаванням солі, перцю, цукру та паприки.
«Залити соусом рулетики, додати вершкового масла, накрити змоченим пергаментом і на 40 хвилин відправити у духовку на 180 градусів, а потім ще запікати 20 хвилин без пергаменту. Це дуже смачно — ніжна цибуля, соковита начинка і солодкуватий соус», — поділилася Людмила Русіна.
Українці за кордоном — останні новини
Українська біженка Людмила Русіна розповіла, що в Німеччині місцеві часто сушать речі просто на вулиці, бо в багатьох будинках це заборонено робити в квартирах і навіть на балконах через ризик появи плісняви, а електричні сушарки потребують додаткових витрат на електроенергію. За її словами, німці цінують такий спосіб за природне провітрювання й особливий аромат білизни, але сама українка не планує користуватися ним постійно, оскільки її договір оренди не забороняє сушіння в приміщенні й проблем із вологістю немає.
Українка Анна, яка разом із трьома дітьми мешкає в таборі для біженців у Лейпцигу, показала у TikTok відеоекскурсію тимчасовим житлом із їдальнею, санвузлами, душовими, захищеними розетками та контрольованим доступом до дитячих кімнат, назвавши містечко затишним і привітним. Попри її позитивні враження, умови проживання в таборі викликали в Мережі неоднозначну реакцію.
Підписуйтесь на наші канали у Telegram та Viber.

title: В Луцке сгорел «Адреналин Сити» после атаки дрона
content_c:
Спасатели потушили пожар, продолжается демонтаж конструкций.
Во вторник, 13 октября, обломки сбитого "шахеда" упали на территорию развлекательного центра «Адреналин Сити». Об этом сообщил исполняющий обязанности начальника областной военной администрации Роман Романюк.
«Произошло возгорание крыши здания развлекательного центра. Силами управления ГСЧС пожар уже удалось локализовать», — отметил глава ОВА.
Он добавил, что в результате атаки погибших или пострадавших нет.
Пожар в культурно-развлекательном центре «Адреналин Сити» в Луцке ликвидировали, — сообщили в ГСЧС и показали последствия возгорания. Продолжается разбор конструкций.

title: Російські удари за тиждень вразили ТЦ "Епіцентр" у Чернігові та Дніпрі і знищили логістичний хаб на Хмельниччині
content_c:
У вівторок ввечері Росія 10 разів атакувала логістичний центр ТОВ "ЕПІЦЕНТР К" у Хмельницькому. Це був останній великий логістичний центр компанії, повідомила керівник департаменту зі зв'язків з громадськістю Епіцентру Юлія Чудновець.
"Наш останній великий логістичний комплекс у Хмельницькій області. 10 влучань. 5 пожеж. Одна за одною. Протягом усього дня… Це був останній великий логістичний комплекс компанії. Два інших – у Києві та Київській області – росіяни вже знищили", – написала Чудновець у Facebook.
За даними компанії, під час атаки на логістичний комплекс у Хмельницькій області протягом дня було зафіксовано 10 влучань, які спричинили п'ять пожеж. Роботу рятувальників із ліквідації займання ускладнювала присутність у небі ще 30 ворожих безпілотників. title: Pakistan has locked down Imran Khan's stronghold - but it could backfire
content_c:
Pakistan has locked down Imran Khan's stronghold - but it could backfire
- Published
Schools closed. The internet partially shut. Roads blocked by shipping containers. And the army arriving in town.
Imran Khan's party stronghold, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, is under a state of emergency, his party's provincial government suspended. It's another dramatic escalation in the standoff between the former prime minister's supporters and Pakistan's state - and one that some fear could lead to more instability, not less.
According to the federal government this step, allowed by the constitution, was needed to provide protection for the province's population from the threat of terror.
"The PTI KPK government was hand in glove with the terrorists," Attah Tarrar, federal information minister, told journalists on Sunday. He did not elaborate or provide evidence, but promised to do so soon.
Two days later there had still been no update from him - but schools had reopened in Peshawar and most parts of the province, and internet services had been restored.
While police would not confirm any detentions, there is clearly a crackdown under way to prevent protests. Most PTI leaders in the province have gone into hiding.
On Tuesday dozens of PTI supporters took to the streets in Bara, Khyber district, hometown of provincial Chief Minister Sohail Afridi. There were reports of tear gas shelling in the area.
To many observers, the timing of Sunday's announcement of emergency rule is not coincidental.
For the last week, thousands of Imran Khan's supporters have marched through Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, where the PTI have been in power for 13 years, demanding Khan's release.
"The charitable response would be to say that it sounded disingenuous," says Farzana Sheikh, associate fellow at Chatham House.
"I do not see the link with terrorism," says Arifa Noor, journalist and commentator. "I'm not even sure if it was the long march itself [that led to this]. Perhaps it was the last straw or perhaps it's just a case of saying, we don't want to deal with the government being in the hands of an opposition party."
The protests were led by Chief Minister Afridi, whose whereabouts are still a mystery. His party says he has been arrested; the government says that he is in protective custody.
Before the march had begun, there had been a crackdown. Three of Khan's sisters were arrested in September, accused among other things of mobilising supporters, and have been detained ever since.
Khan has barely been seen by his family or lawyers in the last year; two of his sisters saw him in August, one in prison, another as he was checked over at a hospital visit after concerns were raised by the Supreme Court about his health, before he was returned behind bars again where he has been held for more than three years.
The PTI leader, who is widely believed to have lost power because of a rift with Pakistan's powerful military, has been imprisoned since August 2023. He is convicted in several corruption cases which he says are politically motivated.
With the party already weakened, why this reaction from the authorities?
"The PTI rank and file has been becoming increasingly restless in recent months amid growing concerns about Imran Khan's health," says Michael Kugelman, senior South Asia fellow at the Atlantic Council.
"There is a sense that perhaps now is the time to send a very strong message to the party and make it more difficult for them to be able to put pressure on the government."
The government has previously argued that Khan was going against jail rules by using his meetings to discuss politics.
Tarar has said of the state of emergency: "There was no political agenda. They could have gone on with their march," and pointed to the talks the two sides had in the run-up to the decision as an indicator that they did try discussion.
But others see this as just another attempt to restrict Khan and his party.
"The government has less and less space for disagreements or dissent and they do not want to negotiate their way out of any kind of conflict," Noor says.
Zahid Hussain, Islamabad-based author and defence analyst, is clear about who is behind the decision.
"The balance of power is completely shifted to the military establishment," he says.
Sheikh thinks that Pakistan's military is feeling confident because it believes it has a good relationship with the White House, its international credentials burnished by their role in the US-Iran peace talks.
"The mode is very much, this is the moment, let's seize it," she says. "There is a sense that, we have all the cards in our hands. We can ride this out internationally."
- Ex-cricket captains urge 'proper medical care' for Imran Khan 
  - Published24 August
- Imran Khan not the only one silenced as Pakistan military stifles dissent 
  - Published29 January
- The cricket star and former PM dividing Pakistan 
  - Published1 February 2024
But Pakistan has plenty to contend with. Militancy is rising. The country was ranked number one in the Global Terrorism Index 2026 as the country which had been affected most.
The country is at loggerheads with two neighbours; it has repeatedly hit Afghanistan with air strikes accusing the Afghan Taliban government of harbouring militant groups, a claim it denies. It would take little to reignite its long-running simmering conflict with India.
Meanwhile, it has promised to help Saudi Arabia defend itself against attacks as the conflict against the Houthis has become increasingly dangerous.
Short of solving one problem, some have warned this state of emergency could lead to more challenges. It risks increasing political instability, with Islamabad taking responsibility for a province without a buffer - the provincial government - they can blame.
"I would argue that this could actually backfire," Kugelman says. "You're playing with fire because if this move ends up adding to the anger and the discontent among so many there, then you have a very big problem on your hands."
"It is reckless, given the challenges, multiple challenges the country is facing," Hussain says. He fears that more of these powers could be used across Pakistan.
Attempts to combat militancy with more active army operations could come with its own perils too, Sheikh argues.
"If they're going to launch these operations, they're going to have to be prepared to accept casualties of members of the armed forces," she says. If those are significant, it could lead to questions inside the military institution, she adds.
Pakistan, with its history of military coups, has examples in its past where removing elected governments, whether provincial or national, can turn sour.
"It's not that senior people in the PML-N [the party in federal government] don't realise that some of these things can come back and haunt them in the future," Noor says.
"Similarly I think to some extent the PTI realises that they will not be able to hold a protest and get Imran Khan out. I think that's the most unfortunate part of this mess that we're in, that we are going into it with our eyes wide open.
"Everybody realises that this is a train crash but somehow you can't stop it."

title: Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer as growth removed during surgery
content_c:
Pope Leo has lung cancer, the Vatican said late on Tuesday.
Leo, 71, underwent an operation and had the lower lobe of his right lung removed, with tests confirming a diagnosis of lung adenocarcinoma, the Vatican said in a medical bulletin, which followed an earlier statement saying the pope’s operation had concluded “successfully, on schedule and as planned”.
The Vatican added that the diagnosis had been suspected by preoperative tests and was confirmed during surgery.
Leo was in the operating theatre for about three hours and the operation itself lasted approximately 90 minutes.
In a rare moment of Vatican transparency, Leo said during his angelus prayer on Sunday that doctors had found a small nodule on his lung during a checkup, adding that it was “well-contained” and detected early.
“The doctors believe it would be right to intervene and so, following their advice, I have decided to have the operation to remove it,” he said to the crowds gathered in St Peter’s Square.
Leo, who in May last year became the first US-born leader of the Roman Catholic church, is being treated in Rome’s Gemelli hospital, where a large crowd greeted his arrival earlier on Tuesday.
The Vatican said that Leo had “now returned to his room” following the operation.
All of his appointments have been cancelled until 20 October.
US secretary of state Marco Rubio, a practicing Catholic who has met with the pope, said he and his wife were “united in prayers” for Leo following the diagnosis. Australian prime minister Anthony Albanese also wished him a quick recovery, saying he was “a voice for peace, humanity and reason in our modern world.”
Cardinal Pietro Parolin, the Vatican secretary of state, said he had seen Leo on Monday night. “We spoke with great serenity,” Parolin told Rai News. “He is truly a great example. The announcement came like a bolt out of the blue, nobody expected it. Thank God it was detected immediately, so the operation could take place immediately. Normally, when these things are caught in time, they can be resolved.”
Leo is staying in the 10th-floor private-patient wing but not in the papal suite, which is being renovated.
The Chicago-born pope, who enjoys sports, especially playing tennis, is generally believed to be in good health. He often makes use of the papal retreat in Castel Gandolfo, close to Rome.
Leo travelled to France on a papal visit in September and is scheduled to go to South America in November for a 12-day trip covering 10 cities.
The weekly papal audience on Wednesday will be led by Luis Antonio Tagle, a cardinal from the Philippines who last week was elected dean of the college of cardinals – the authority that presides over papal conclaves.
The Gemelli, located in the north-west of the Italian capital, is renowned for treating reigning popes. Pope John Paul II stayed there so many times that the Vatican worked with the hospital to establish the high-security papal suite.
Leo’s predecessor, Francis, spent more than five weeks in the hospital, being treated for bronchitis, which developed into bilateral pneumonia. He died at home in Casa Santa Marta in Vatican City on 21 April 2025, just under a month after being discharged.

title: DR Congo: Kabila’s move towards M23 raises questions over peace
content_c:
What Kabila's new armed coalition means for the DRC conflict
October 13, 2026
Joseph Kabila's decision to lead a new political-military movement, the Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN), puts the former president of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) in more direct confrontation with President Felix Tshisekedi's government. Kabila announced the FRN on October 12 in Goma, eastern DRC, at his residence, where leaders of the AFC/M23 rebel movements joined him.
FRN coalition adviser, Claude Ibalanky, said the group would unite opposition forces, including figures associated with the AFC/M23 movement. The new structure succeeds the Congo River Alliance (AFC), which had been allied with the M23 rebellion. Its leadership includes former AFC leader Corneille Nangaa and M23 political leader Bertrand Bisimwa. Sultani Makenga, a senior M23 military commander, was also assigned a senior role in the new organization.
The announcement comes as diplomatic initiatives seek to end fighting between Congolese government forces and the rebellion.
Congolese authorities have accused Kabila of supporting the insurgency, allegations he has denied. On September 30, 2025, a military court sentenced him to death in absentia after convicting him of treason, war crimes and other offenses linked to the conflict in eastern DRC. Kabila has rejected the case as politically motivated.
Adolph Amisi Makutano, an official of the ruling Union for Democracy and Social Progress (UDPS), criticized the former president for taking a more public role.
"It was a lack of courage that made this gentleman drag his feet. They held several meetings and today he is being pushed to step out into the open. But it is a disgrace for the DRC," Makutano said.
Why is eastern Congo at war?
Eastern DRC has experienced decades of conflict involving armed groups, competition over territory andmineral resources, and tensions with neighboring countries.
The aftermath of Rwanda's 1994 genocide against the Tutsicontributed to successive regional conflicts, as armed groups and refugees crossed borders and neighboring states became involved in Congo's civil wars.
M23 takes its name from a March 23, 2009, peace agreement. The movement says the Congolese government failed to honor commitments to integrate its fighters and protect minority Congolese Tutsis.
Kinshasa, the United Nations (UN) and Western governments haveaccused Rwanda of supporting M23 and exercising influence over its operations. Rwanda denies backing the rebellion and cites security threats posed by armed groups operating in Congo. In 2025, M23 captured Goma and Bukavu, two major cities in eastern Congo. Its territorial gains weakened government control across parts of the region, displaced civilians and intensified an already severe humanitarian crisis.
Kabila's leadership of the new front raises questions about whether he intends to consolidate opposition to Tshisekedi, strengthen the rebellion's political leadership, or pursue both.
Political implications of Kabila's move
Alex Vines, Africa program director at the European Council on Foreign Relations, sees the move as evidence that Kabila remains politically ambitious. "It shows Kabila's political ambition is alive and kicking and he is prepared to challenge Tshisekedi," Vines told DW.
Timo Roujean, head of the Konrad Adenauer Foundation's office in Kinshasa, cautioned against assessing Kabila's potential support based on ethnic identity alone. He told DW that economic performance and political dynamics in Kabila's home region of Katanga are also relevant.
The new front could give the movement more explicitly political leadership, but it remains unclear whether the reorganization will broaden its domestic support or alter its negotiating position. Conflict analyst Cliffton Chifuwe told DW the alliance does not rule out a negotiated settlement, but could make a durable agreement harder to achieve.
"The Kabila alliance with M23 does not make peace impossible. However, it raises the threshold for achieving that settlement and its ability to hold," Chifuwe told DW.
For Chifuwe, lasting peace requires more than a cessation of hostilities. It also depends on credible security arrangements, the restoration of state authority, humanitarian access, and conditions that allow displaced people to return safely. The new FRN coalition also raises questions for mediators about whether existing peace frameworks can accommodate the political realignment and whether the parties involved can ensure compliance with any agreement.
As this new development plays out, the central issue for civilians in eastern Congo remains whether the leadership change will open a path to settlement or make an already complex conflict harder to resolve.
Wendy Bashi, Saleh Mwanamilongo and Jean Noel Ba Mweze contributed to this article
Edited by: Chrispin Mwakideu

Eastern DRC has experienced decades of conflict involving armed groups, competition over territory andmineral resources, and tensions with neighboring countries.
The aftermath of Rwanda's 1994 genocide against the Tutsicontributed to successive regional conflicts, as armed groups and refugees crossed borders and neighboring states became involved in Congo's civil wars.
M23 takes its name from a March 23, 2009, peace agreement. The movement says the Congolese government failed to honor commitments to integrate its fighters and protect minority Congolese Tutsis.
Kinshasa, the United Nations (UN) and Western governments haveaccused Rwanda of supporting M23 and exercising influence over its operations. Rwanda denies backing the rebellion and cites security threats posed by armed groups operating in Congo. In 2025, M23 captured Goma and Bukavu, two major cities in eastern Congo. Its territorial gains weakened government control across parts of the region, displaced civilians and intensified an already severe humanitarian crisis.
Kabila's leadership of the new front raises questions about whether he intends to consolidate opposition to Tshisekedi, strengthen the rebellion's political leadership, or pursue both.
Political implications of Kabila's move
Alex Vines, Africa program director at the European Council on Foreign Relations, sees the move as evidence that Kabila remains politically ambitious. "It shows Kabila's political ambition is alive and kicking and he is prepared to challenge Tshisekedi," Vines told DW.
Timo Roujean, head of the Konrad Adenauer Foundation's office in Kinshasa, cautioned against assessing Kabila's potential support based on ethnic identity alone. He told DW that economic performance and political dynamics in Kabila's home region of Katanga are also relevant.
The new front could give the movement more explicitly political leadership, but it remains unclear whether the reorganization will broaden its domestic support or alter its negotiating position. Conflict analyst Cliffton Chifuwe told DW the alliance does not rule out a negotiated settlement, but could make a durable agreement harder to achieve.
"The Kabila alliance with M23 does not make peace impossible. However, it raises the threshold for achieving that settlement and its ability to hold," Chifuwe told DW.
For Chifuwe, lasting peace requires more than a cessation of hostilities. It also depends on credible security arrangements, the restoration of state authority, humanitarian access, and conditions that allow displaced people to return safely. The new FRN coalition also raises questions for mediators about whether existing peace frameworks can accommodate the political realignment and whether the parties involved can ensure compliance with any agreement.
As this new development plays out, the central issue for civilians in eastern Congo remains whether the leadership change will open a path to settlement or make an already complex conflict harder to resolve.
Wendy Bashi, Saleh Mwanamilongo and Jean Noel Ba Mweze contributed to this article

title: Papst Leo XIV. hat Lungenkrebs
content_c:
71 Jahre alt Papst Leo hat Lungenkrebs
Papst Leo XIV. ist nach Angaben seiner behandelnden Ärzte an Lungenkrebs erkrankt. Dies teilte das Mediziner-Team der Gemelli-Klinik in Rom nach einer Operation des 71-Jährigen mit. Bei dem etwa anderthalbstündigen Eingriff sei der untere Lappen der rechten Lunge des Oberhauptes der katholischen Kirche entfernt worden. Die anschließende Untersuchung habe bestätigt, dass es sich bei dem Knoten um ein sogenanntes Lungenadenokarzinom handele.
Der Verdacht darauf sei bereits bei den Untersuchungen vor dem Eingriff aufgekommen, hieß es. Dieser sei nun bestätigt worden. Die Operation verlief nach Angaben der Ärzte »erfolgreich und ohne Komplikationen«. Der Papst sei anschließend wie geplant aufgewacht und befinde sich nun in seinem Zimmer.
Leo gab Knoten an der Lunge selbst bekannt
Leo hatte am Sonntag überraschend bekannt gegeben, dass bei einer Kontrolluntersuchung in seiner Lunge ein Knoten entdeckt worden sei, noch in einem »sehr frühen Stadium«. Auf Anraten der Ärzte habe er sich zu einer Operation entschlossen. Der Eingriff erfolgte jetzt nur zwei Tage später.
Bis dahin waren keinerlei gesundheitlichen Probleme des ersten US-Amerikaners an der Spitze der katholischen Kirche bekannt. Leo hält sich mit Tennis, Schwimmen und regelmäßigen Übungen fit. Mit seinen 71 Jahren ist er immer noch ein verhältnismäßig junger Papst. Bei seiner Wahl im Mai vergangenen Jahres wurde gemutmaßt, dass er ein langes Pontifikat vor sich haben werde, möglicherweise mehrere Jahrzehnte lang.
Voraussichtlich eine Woche lang im Krankenhaus
Leo liegt im Gemelli-Krankenhaus, wo auch mehrere seiner Vorgänger schon behandelt wurden. Die Päpste haben dort einen eigenen Trakt, in dem sie rund um die Uhr versorgt werden. In einer ersten offiziellen Mitteilung hieß es: »Der Eingriff verlief erfolgreich, wurde termingerecht und wie vorgesehen durchgeführt.« Nun soll der Papst etwa eine Woche Erholung bekommen.
Vor der Operation war davon die Rede, dass sich Leo voraussichtlich etwa eine Woche lang im Krankenhaus erholen müssen. In der Gemelli-Klinik am Rande der italienischen Hauptstadt gibt es einen Trakt für Päpste im zehnten Stock. Dort wurde bis kurz vor seinem Tod mit 88 Jahren auch Leos Vorgänger behandelt, Papst Franziskus. Dem Argentinier fehlte bereits seit jungen Jahren ein Teil seiner Lunge.

title: Marktbericht: DAX driftet ins Minus
content_c:
Tech-Sorgen DAX driftet ins Minus
Am Ende konnte der DAX sein Plus nicht mehr halten. Neue Sorgen im Chipsektor und ein enttäuschender Start in die Berichtssaison lasteten auf den Kursen.
Eigentlich hatte es nach einem guten Börsentag ausgesehen. Weder von den Anleihemärkten noch vom Ölpreis gab es echten Druck. Belastend wirkten aber neue Sorgen um den Technologiesektor.
Berichte über die Entwicklung leistungsfähiger KI-Chips durch das chinesische Unternehmen CXMT lösten massive Gewinnmitnahmen bei Halbleiteraktien in Südkorea und anderen asiatischen Märkten aus. "Die technologische Konkurrenz aus dem Reich der Mitte nährt die Sorge, wie lange sich die hohen Bewertungen und Gewinnmargen der etablierten Chipkonzerne noch rechtfertigen lassen", sagte Marktanalyst Andreas Lipkow vom Broker CMC Markets.
Bereits am Vorabend an der Wall Street waren Halbleiteraktien verkauft worden. Anleger betrachten die hohen Bewertungen im Sektor ohnehin schon länger mit Misstrauen.
Der DAX, der am Vormittag noch 0,7 Prozent gewonnen hatte, musste seinen Tagesgewinn abgeben und schloss 0,1 Prozent tiefer bei 25.259 Punkten. Am Montag hatte der deutsche Leitindex noch knapp 0,8 Prozent zugelegt.
Noch schwerer als die Chipwerte wog der holprige Start in die Berichtssaison zum dritten Quartal. Wie immer eröffneten die großen US-Banken den Zahlenreigen. JPMorgan, Wells Fargo und Goldman Sachs meldeten zwar durchweg steigende Quartalsgewinne. Aber nur Goldman konnte die hohen Erwartungen übertreffen.
Am Ölmarkt entspannten sich die Preise zunächst, zogen im Verlauf aber wieder etwas an. Nordseeöl der Sorte Brent notierte am frühen Abend knapp unter 106 Dollar pro Barrel.
Nach wie vor warten die Märkte auf eine offizielle Stellungnahme Teherans zu den jüngsten Antworten aus Washington. Während es hier noch Hoffnung gibt, deuten die Angriffe der Huthi-Miliz aus dem Jemen auf die saudi-arabische Hauptstadt Riad eher auf eine weitere Eskalation auf der Arabischen Halbinsel hin.
Auch die US-Märkte stehen ganz unter dem Eindruck der startenden Berichtssaison und der schwelenden Technologiesorgen. Sowohl die Standard- als auch die Technologiewerte gaben zunächst leicht nach.
Die neue Wirtschaftsprognose des Internationalen Währungsfonds (IWF) stützte die Kurse etwas. Die Organisation erhöhte ihre Wachstumsprognose für Deutschland und die Weltwirtschaft. Der IWF rechnet nun damit, dass das deutsche Bruttoinlandsprodukt (BIP) im laufenden Jahr um 1,3 Prozent wächst.
Das sind 0,6 Prozentpunkte mehr als noch im Juli prognostiziert. Auch die Bundesregierung geht derzeit von 1,3 Prozent Wachstum aus. Seine Erwartung für die globale Wirtschaftsleistung hob der IWF ebenfalls leicht um 0,1 Prozentpunkte auf 3,1 Prozent an.
Mit der Eintrübung der Technologierally wurden auch am deutschen Markt wieder die "üblichen Verdächtigen" verkauft. Im DAX war der Münchener Halbleiterhersteller Infineon größter Verlierer. Im MDAX gaben Aktien wie Aixtron, Siltronic, Elmos und Suss Microtec nach.
Die Symrise-Aktie profitierte von starken Umsatzzahlen des Schweizer Konkurrenten Givaudan. Die Aktie des Aromen- und Duftstoffherstellers setzte sich an die Spitze der DAX-Gewinner und erreichte den höchsten Stand seit Sommer 2025.

title: Магнітна буря 14 жовтня: скільки балів буде
content_c:
Магнітна буря 14 жовтня: скільки балів буде
Незабаром очікується посилення геомагнітної активності.
Сьогодні, 14 жовтня, жовтня, магнітна буря трохи слабне. Очікується збурення з К-індексом 4 (жовтий рівень).
Про це повідомляють портал meteoagent та Британська геологічна служба.
Наразі геомагнітні умови досить спокійні. Втім, можливе посилення геомагнітної активності через вплив корональних викидів маси та потоку швидкого сонячного вітру. Протягом найближчої доби не виключені магнітні бурі рівня G1, а подекуди — короткочасно G2.
Зауважимо, що магнітні бурі впливають на здоров’я людей. Особливо схильні до погіршення самопочуття метеозалежні, особи з гіпертонією та серцево-судинними захворюваннями. У них можуть бути головний біль, підвищений тиск, слабкість, безсоння тощо.

title: Лига чемпионов: результаты всех матчей дня 13 октября, турнирная таблица
content_c:
Во вторник, 13 октября, прошли первые матчи второго тура основного раунда Лиги чемпионов сезона-2026/27.
В центральном матче дня "Атлетико" обыграло "Манчестер Юнайтед", а главной сенсацией стала результативная ничья норвежского "Викинга" против мюнхенской "Баварии".
Результаты всех матчей дня
"Ланс" (Франция) — "Спортинг" (Португалия) — 0:2
Голы: Суарес, 22, Думбия, 74
"Сабах" (Азербайджан) — "Славия" (Чехия) — 2:0
Голы: Пэррис, 49, Микельс, 88
"Арсенал" (Англия) — "Лилль" (Франция) — 3:0
Голы: Тимбер, 64, Эзе, 67, Сака, 71
"Атлетико" Мадрид (Испания) — "Манчестер Юнайтед" (Англия) — 2:0
Голы: Барриос, 1, Лукман, 79
"Викинг" (Норвегия) — "Бавария" (Германия) — 3:3
Голы: Стенснесс, 2, Кристиансен, 38, Г. Гауген, 90 — Кейн, 54 (с пенальти), 60, Диас, 71
"Вильярреал" (Испания) — "Наполи" (Италия) — 3:1
Голы: Микаутадзе, 23, Моуриньо, 26, Олувасейи, 86 — Ррахмани, 8
"Галатасарай" (Турция) — "Барселона" (Испания) — 1:4
Голы: Батраков, 28 — Канселу, 43, Фермин Лопес, 50, Гордон, 53, Адейеми, 65
"Интер" (Италия) — "Брюгге" (Бельгия) — 3:4
Голы: Лаутаро Мартинес, 44, 81, Бонни, 90 — Тресольди, 30 (с пенальти), 63, 74, Вермант, 87
"Лейпциг" (Германия) — ПСВ (Нидерланды) — 1:0
Гол: Груда, 70
Турнирная таблица
Это третий розыгрыш ЛЧ после масштабной реформы турнира. Вместо группового этапа команды выступают в единой лиге и проведут по восемь матчей с разными соперниками. Плей-офф пройдет в привычном формате.
Действующим победителем ЛЧ является французский ПСЖ, который в финале в серии пенальти обыграл "Арсенал".
Финальный матч Лиги чемпионов нового сезона запланирован на 5 июня 2027 года в Мадриде на стадионе "Метрополитано".
Ранее сообщалось о том, что звездный футболист "Реала" Мбаппе убрал со стола спонсорский напиток перед матчем Лиги чемпионов.

title: Україна має найкращий з 2022 року шанс перехопити стратегічну ініціативу у війні – Iнститут вивчення війни
content_c:
Україна наразі має найкращу з грудня 2022 року можливість перехопити стратегічну ініціативу у війні проти РФ, проте Сполучені Штати та Європа ризикують змарнувати цей шанс через спроби Кремля нав'язати Заходу реактивну позицію та зірвати темп українських операцій, йдеться у звіті Інституту вивчення війни (IВВ) у вівторок.
"Кремль, на відміну від США та інших партнерів України, усвідомлює, що Росія є критично вразливою до ініціативи, темпу та тривалого тиску. Кремль уважно стежить за утриманням ініціативи Україною та її партнерами і прагне стримати та зірвати її за будь-яку ціну", – наголошують аналітики у дослідженні.
За оцінкою IВВ, Збройні сили України повернули оперативну ініціативу на більшості ключових напрямків і оскаржують стратегічну ініціативу РФ із кінця 2025 року. У 2026 році українські війська сповільнили просування росіян до швидкості пішої ходи – менш як 1 кв. км на добу. Завдяки українським контрнаступам, під час яких було звільнено щонайменше 1,046 тис. кв. км території, чистий територіальний здобуток армії РФ від початку 2026 року становив лише близько 100 кв. км.
Фахівці зазначають, що літній наступ РФ провалився, і осіння кампанія, ймовірно, матиме такий самий результат, а володимир путін досі не досяг жодної із заявлених цілей у війні та далекий від захоплення решти Донецької області. Успіхи України на полі бою у 2026 році є результатом трансформації війська, розширення оборонного виробництва, розвитку далекобійних ударів та роботи над власною балістичною програмою, яка поставить під ще більший удар російський оборонно-промисловий комплекс (ОПК).
Окремо в ІВВ вказують на ефективність ударів углиб території РФ та західних санкцій, які вивели з ладу щонайменше 30% російських нафтопереробних потужностей і спричинили дефіцит пального. Це змусило Москву закуповувати перероблене паливо в Індії, зазнаючи додаткових витрат, а на тлі падіння доходів від енергоекспорту Мінфін РФ оголосив про намір збільшити закупівлю іноземної валюти та золота з 7 жовтня до 6 листопада 2026 року. Саме для зриву цього тиску Кремль вдається до когнітивної війни, зокрема пропонуючи постачати незначні обсяги дизельного пального на світові ринки в обмін на послаблення санкцій.
Водночас, за даними аналітиків, кампанія стратегічних бомбардувань України у 2026 році з використанням балістичних ракет і реактивних дронів має на меті перекрити українські успіхи та спричинити максимальний терор серед цивільних. Кремль прагне зробити великі українські міста непридатними для життя цілодобовими ударами по поштових хабах і мостах, посіяти недовіру до влади, ізолювати країну від європейської логістики та змусити ЗСУ обирати між прикриттям тилу і підтримкою фронту. Паралельно РФ нарощує гібридні атаки проти країн НАТО – вторгнення дронів і ракет, диверсії, підпали та вбивства, щоб нейтралізувати Альянс і створити для європейського ОПК хибну дилему між допомогою Києву та власною обороною.
Для уникнення затяжної та масштабнішої війни в Інституті закликають партнерів України засвоїти уроки осені 2022 року, коли ядерний шантаж Кремля під час контрнаступів у Харківській та Херсонській областях загальмував постачання західної зброї.
На думку експертів, союзники мають діяти на випередження за чотирма ключовими напрямами: терміново масштабувати засоби протидії російським реактивним дронам, посилити санкції проти енергосектору РФ із одночасною підтримкою українських далекобійних ударів, а також розробити дієві механізми стримування гібридних атак РФ на території самої Європи. Крім того, виділення кредиту Європейського Союзу для України має відійти від практики поступового дозування допомоги і забезпечити українському командуванню ресурс для планування послідовних операцій на весь наступний рік.

title: What we know about the man who died falling from a Six Flags rollercoaster
content_c:
What we know about the man who died falling from a Six Flags rollercoaster
- Published
Warning: This story includes distressing content
A man has died after falling from a rollercoaster at a Six Flags amusement park on Monday in the US state of Georgia.
The man, Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem, 42, was found dead under the ride after being ejected and hitting other people on it, according to police.
An investigation is under way and few details have yet to be released about what happened. Six Flags, the largest amusement park operator in North America, has temporarily closed nine rides across the US and Canada as a precaution.
Here's what we know so far about the incident.
What happened?
The Cobb County Police Department said the incident at the Six Flags Over Georgia park happened just before 16:00 local time (20:00 GMT) on Monday.
"Officers working at the park responded to an incident involving a male guest on a roller coaster," it said in a statement on Tuesday.
"Preliminary information gathered through witness and employee interview indicates Kariem was ejected from the ride and struck other patrons before falling beneath the attraction."
The ride involved has not been specified but aerial footage from news helicopters showed the Goliath rollercoaster stopped midway, and multiple witnesses have identified the ride as the one involved in the incident.
The office of the state's insurance and fire safety commissioner, which enforces amusement park safety rules in Georgia, is also conducting a review.
Officials have not held a news conference on the incident.
The Goliath ride opened in 2006, and it has an elevation of 200ft (60m), a 170ft plunge, a 540-degree spiral, and a speed of up to 70mph (112km/h), according to the park website. On its "thrill scale", Six Flags ranks Goliath at level four out of five.
The company said in a statement that it was "deeply saddened by the guest incident" and that "our thoughts and heartfelt condolences are with the guest's family, friends, and loved ones".
Witnesses recount 'traumatic' moments
Nick Mendenhall said he witnessed the fatal moments in disbelief, watching the man come out of his seat and then fall into another cart on the ride before falling to the ground.
"It was just super, super bizarre, traumatic. I mean, it took me a couple of seconds, I feel like, to process what was going on," he told the AP. "I cant believe that I just saw that."
He said his mind instantly went to the trauma of all of those impacted by what he witnessed, including the man's loved ones and everyone who was on the ride with him.
One witness told NBC affiliate WXIA that the incident was captured in souvenir photos that were automatically taken of the rollercoaster while it was in motion. The BBC has not been able to verify this statement.
Connor Thompson told the BBC's US partner CBS News that he was in line for the ride when everyone started "yelling, clearly distressed".
"Everyone was kind of confused at first, and then there was someone who was yelling, 'Call 911! Someone fell out!" he said. "At first it was almost like I didn't believe it because I thought that was like impossible for something like that to happen."
He said he saw the cart come into the hub where others were waiting in line and could see the restraint was unlatched.
Another witness, CiCi Nelson, told CNN she, too, was in line to ride the Goliath when the rollercoaster returned and she saw an empty seat with a loose safety bar and a female covered in blood.
Nelson described a scene of hysteria, adding that one man was "freaking out, saying someone fell off".
Brittany Landry, who believed she saw Kariem ejected from the rollercoaster, told Fox News she was in tears.
"I broke because we were just on there," she said.
Who is the victim Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem?
Kariem's family said he was a father, passionate educator and had survived two bouts of cancer.
His family told WXIA that he had survived cancer twice - the last stint in 2018 - and was in a car crash with his 10-year-old daughter three weeks before his death.
He lived in the nearby city of Atlanta and worked for Wesley International Academy, a public charter school, for more than 12 years as an IT manager, technology teacher and robotics coach.
"Mr. Kariem was deeply loved and respected, and his absence will be felt throughout our school community," the school said in a statement posted to its Facebook account.
"His love for Wesley, dedication to our students, and commitment to our school community were evident in everything he did."
Outside of work, Kariem enjoyed creating products with his laser engraver and 3D printers, as well as cooking, watching anime and spending time with family and friends, according to his profile on the school's website.
Has this happened before?
The death at Six Flags Over Georgia is at least the seventh there, according to the Doan Law Firm, which tracks amusement park accidents and represents victims.
According to the firm, this includes two people who had medical emergencies, two who were in restricted areas when they were struck by a ride, two who died in car-related accidents and one who died months after using the park's pool.
Six Flags operates 20 amusement parks, 14 water parks and nine resorts across Canada, the US and Mexico.
In the last 15 years, two deaths caused by falling from the park's rollercoasters led to lawsuits and settlements. One in 2011 involved an Iraq War veteran who was ejected from a ride in New York and hit his head on the car. In the other, in 2013, a woman slipped from her restraints on a rollercoaster in Texas and fell 75 feet.
In September, the Six Flags Magic Mountain park in California announced it was closing its X2 rollercoaster after more 100 people alleged that they had suffered brain injuries from the ride.
With additional reporting by Brandon Drenon

title: Iranian woman handed death sentence for ‘blasphemy’ in social media post
content_c:
Human rights groups have raised the alarm over the growing number of death sentences and executions in Iran, after reports that a 23-year-old woman, Najmeh Amini, has been sentenced to death for blasphemy over a social-media post.
Amini, an accounting student, is being held in Vakilabad prison in the north-east city of Mashhad. She has been sentenced to more than 12 years in prison and death in separate cases heard by a revolutionary and a criminal court.
A source close to Amini’s family told the US-based Human Rights Activists in Iran (HRAI) that Amini was sentenced to death on charges of “sab ol-nabi” (insulting the prophet).
In the second case, Amini was sentenced to 12 years, six months and one day on charges including acting against national security and spreading propaganda against the regime.
Amini was arrested by security forces during January’s nationwide protests, which were suppressed with a deadly crackdown. Thousands were reported killed, while the HRAI news agency, Hrana, said more than 50,000 people were arrested.
In an audio recording released from the prison last month, Amini appealed for international intervention, calling on the UN, lawyers and rights groups to investigate her case.
“I do not want to make a hero out of myself today. I only want one thing: be my voice,” she said.
“I am an innocent young girl with so many hopes and dreams,” Amini said. “I have parents who are waiting for me. A family that every night, with the fear of losing me, turns their night into morning.”
Rights groups warn that the Iranian authorities are increasingly using capital punishment to instil fear and suppress dissent. According to the Oslo-based Iran Human Rights (IHRNGO), more than 600 executions have already been carried out this year.
Mahmood Amiry-Moghaddam, director of IHRNGO, said Amini’s case should be seen as a serious warning.
“Sentencing a young woman to death for what she posted on social media risks normalising the use of the death penalty against peaceful expression and pushing the boundaries of the death penalty even further,” he said.
Amiry-Moghaddam added that the Iranian authorities were testing the international community’s “tolerance” towards capital punishment. “If the international community does not respond firmly now, cases like this could become far more common,” he said.
Under article 262 of Iran’s Islamic penal code, insulting the prophet Muhammad or revered Shia figures is punishable by death. However, article 263 provides exemptions for statements made while intoxicated or without deliberate intent, although offenders may still face up to 74 lashes in certain circumstances.
According to the Iranian newspaper Khorasan, which confirmed the judicial proceedings, Amini told the court she had posted the remarks while hallucinating after taking psychedelic mushrooms with friends and her defence argued it was a “slip of the tongue”.
The presiding judge rejected her defence, reportedly asking: “Why, in that same hallucinatory state, did you not insult other individuals or opponents of the regime, such as America and Israel?”
Amini’s death sentence is not final and remains subject to appeal before Iran’s supreme court.
The student’s sentencing comes at a time when Iranian lawmakers are seeking to criminalise contact with all foreign media, including posts on social media deemed to be financed by another country.
Elnaz*, 24, who took part in the protests in Tehran in January and was arrested over social-media posts at the height of the war in March, said she lived in constant fear of surveillance.
“I was arrested even though my social-media account was private. So it’s not just the regime’s cyber-police we have to worry about. There’s also this constant mistrust, this feeling that someone is watching me all the time, even when I’m alone in my room.
“I’m scared to post anything on social media … but after everything they’ve put us through, do we really have anything left to lose? They can kill us even if we don’t post anything on social media.”
Although executions in Iran have surged in recent years, reaching their highest level in three decades, death sentences for blasphemy remain relatively rare. The last documented case was on 8 May 2023, when Yousef Mehrad and Sadrollah Fazeli-Zare were executed after being convicted of blasphemy-related offences tied to social-media activity.
* Name has been changed to protect her identity

Human rights groups have raised the alarm over the growing number of death sentences and executions in Iran, after reports that a 23-year-old woman, Najmeh Amini, has been sentenced to death for blasphemy over a social-media post.
Amini, an accounting student, is being held in Vakilabad prison in the north-east city of Mashhad. She has been sentenced to more than 12 years in prison and death in separate cases heard by a revolutionary and a criminal court.
A source close to Amini’s family told the US-based Human Rights Activists in Iran (HRAI) that Amini was sentenced to death on charges of “sab ol-nabi” (insulting the prophet).
In the second case, Amini was sentenced to 12 years, six months and one day on charges including acting against national security and spreading propaganda against the regime.
Amini was arrested by security forces during January’s nationwide protests, which were suppressed with a deadly crackdown. Thousands were reported killed, while the HRAI news agency, Hrana, said more than 50,000 people were arrested.

title: India: Can 'cockroaches' threaten Modi's political grip?
content_c:
India: Can 'cockroaches' threaten Modi's political grip?
October 13, 2026
India's Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) may have anticipated pushback from the government after its first round of protests in July, but the scale of barricading and detentions that greeted its leaders in a fortress-like New Delhi on October 10 was unlike anything they had anticipated.
The CJP began as a satirical online movement after the chief justice of India, Surya Kant, referred to unemployed young people as "cockroaches" in an offhand remark. The name is an ironic riff on the name of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
In its latest round of agitation, they are demanding the resignation of the country's controversy-hit Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, after more than 130 million names were reportedly removed from electoral rolls nationwide.
What happened over the weekend?
CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke, accompanied by co-conveners Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das, was detained from the plane in which he landed in the national capital on Saturday.
Meanwhile, police were stationed outside the homes of several other faces associated with the movement, including social media personality Dhruv Rathee, who has nearly 20 million followers on Instagram.
In central Delhi, buses were loaded with protesters, many of whom were taken to far-flung centers, where they were kept for hours. According to local media, at least 3,000 people were detained across the city.
How the government is handling the protests
The protests come as Modi marks 25 uninterrupted years leading elected governments, first in Gujarat state as chief minister and then as prime minister of India.
Ironically, "this celebration has happened at the time when he's politically at his weakest," Delhi-based writer Nilanjan Mukhopadhyay told DW. Mukhopadhyay is the author of Modi's 2013 biography "Narendra Modi: The Man, The Times."
He contrasted the government's current response with its approach in July, when thousands of young protesters took to the streets to demand the resignation of Modi's education minister over repeated exam paper leaks.
At the time, authorities had used batons, detentions and pellets to disperse the crowds gathered in central Delhi, which had been on the streets for days.
This time, authorities shifted to mass security deployments and preemptive action on a large scale. This included notices to those associated with earlier protests, transport cuts, the internet cutoff and airport arrests.
"The government has learned from its previous experience. They didn't allow people to sit at Jantar Mantar for any length of time, so it couldn't balloon," Pearl Pandya, senior analyst for Asia at global monitor ACLED, told DW.
"What's worrying is whether this becomes a playbook for the future — that you are not allowed to protest in the first place," she added, referring to the government's decision to remove the 18th-century observatory Jantar Mantar in central Delhi from the list of designated protest sites.
Authorities, however, have announced three new designated protest sites in the national capital.
Mukhopadhyay had a different reading of the situation. "The scale of this deployment is actually a defeat for Mr. Modi," he said.
Mukhopadhyay argued that it was already a setback for the government if it was forced to deploy security forces on such a scale in response to protests from a completely new socio-political movement.
Why October hasn't matched July
Despite the momentum, the CJP has not been able to replicate its success from July, with the protests against Kumar being led primarily by opposition leaders and student organizations.
"Education was far more of a cross-cutting issue... the right to vote is still seen as an intrinsically political one, where it's the opposition versus the BJP," Pandya said.
The CJP, however, has long maintained that it is non-political. This is often cited as the reason for them amassing such a large following of young followers.
Mukhopadhyay criticized that stance, saying: "You cannot raise issues about electoral neutrality... without saying that these are political issues."
Despite the differences between the previous round of CJP protests in July and the current wave of demonstrations, sociologist Surinder Singh Jodhka emphasized continuity.
"I don't think they're qualitatively different. Once again, young people are the ones who are mobilized, and they are much more encouraged because the earlier round of protests was successful," he told DW. "And it's also asking similar questions about institutions, about democracy, about transparency and accountability."
"There is a new hope for those who had earlier given up on India, and felt like the right wing was in complete control," Jodhka added.
Abrupt change of government unlikely
Dismissing comparisons with volatile protests in neighboring Nepal and Bangladesh, which brought down their governments, the analysts pointed to India's strong institutions as a safeguard against a dramatic change of government.
"India has had a very strong state system and state institutions," Jodhka explained, highlighting that even the opposition parties were asking for "the revival of institutions, rather than an overthrow of the state."
Pandya also stated that faith in the judiciary "would prevent these protests from tipping over into a popular revolution which unseats the government."
Nevertheless, she said, sustained discontent "might come to bite the government in 2029... or before that in the state elections."
It could also erode Modi's popularity, which has been a defining feature of Indian politics over the past decade, the expert indicated.
For Mukhopadhyay, the most troubling aspect of the current protests is the erosion of the electoral body's credibility.
Recalling the pride he felt when he registered to vote at 21, he drew comparisons with young Indian voters today. "The youngsters are now fighting for their vote."
Edited by: Srinivas Mazumdaru
description: Thousands detained, leaders arrested on arrival, and a capital under lockdown: The youth-led protests against the election chief have the attention of the Indian government. But experts say toppling it is another matter.

title: Tupac Shakur: Bandenchef Duane Davis erhält mindestens 40 Jahre Gefängnis
content_c:
Legendärer US-Rapper Mord an Tupac Shakur – Bandenchef Duane Davis erhält mindestens 40 Jahre
Gut 30 Jahre nach dem Mord an US-Rapper Tupac Shakur ist der frühere Gang-Anführer Duane Davis (63) zu mindestens 40 Jahren Haft verurteilt worden. Richterin Carlin Kierny verkündete das Strafmaß am Dienstag in Las Vegas (US-Bundesstaat Nevada) – rund sechs Wochen nachdem Geschworene einen Schuldspruch verhängt hatten.
Die Jury in dem mehrwöchigen Prozess sah es als erwiesen an, dass er als Drahtzieher für den Tod des Rappers verantwortlich war. Davis, der in Handschellen vor Gericht erschien, erklärte gemeinsam mit seinem Anwalt, dass er in Berufung gehen werde.
Erfolgs-Rapper Tupac Shakur starb 1996
Tupac Shakur war einer der einflussreichsten und erfolgreichsten Rapper der Neunzigerjahre und gilt bis heute für den Hip-Hop als eine prägende Figur. Der für Hits wie »California Love« und »Changes« bekannte Musiker verkaufte weltweit Millionen Platten. Der damals 25 Jahre alte Rapper wurde am 7. September 1996 in einem Auto in Las Vegas angeschossen und starb sechs Tage später im Krankenhaus.
Davis wurde in dem Prozess nicht beschuldigt, selbst auf Shakur geschossen zu haben. Die Staatsanwaltschaft sah in dem früheren Anführer der Straßengang South Side Compton Crips vielmehr den Drahtzieher des tödlichen Angriffs im Umfeld rivalisierender Gruppen. Nach Darstellung der Anklage organisierte Davis die Vergeltungsaktion und beschaffte die Waffe. Nach dem Recht des Bundesstaates Nevada kann auch jemand wegen Mordes verurteilt werden, der anderen bei der Tat hilft.
Lange Ermittlungen
Der frühere Gang-Anführer war 2023 in Las Vegas festgenommen und unter anderem wegen Mordes mit Gebrauch einer tödlichen Waffe angeklagt worden. Er plädierte auf nicht schuldig.
Lange fehlten ausreichende Beweise, um den Fall vor Gericht zu bringen. Am Ende hätten unter anderem Davis' eigene Worte die Untersuchungen weitergebracht, erklärte die Polizei.
Davis hatte mehrfach öffentlich darüber gesprochen, dass er in dem weißen Cadillac gesessen habe, aus dem die Schüsse auf Shakur abgefeuert worden seien. Er sei der einzige Insasse, der noch lebe, gab er in Interviews und in seiner Autobiografie an. Die tödlichen Schüsse habe sein Neffe abgegeben, sagte er 2008 in einem Verhör.
Um die früheren Äußerungen zu entkräften, hatte Verteidiger Michael Sanft seinen Mandanten in dem Prozess als Lügner und Angeber dargestellt. Dieser habe viele Dinge erfunden, um daraus Kapital zu schlagen. Physische Beweismittel dafür, dass Davis tatsächlich am Tatort war, gab es in dem Verfahren nicht.
description: Drei Jahrzehnte nach dem Tod des Rappers wird der Bandenchef Duane Davis in Las Vegas zu mindestens 40 Jahren Haft verurteilt. Beim Prozess spielten auch Aussagen in seinen Memoiren eine Rolle.
